# WP1-c: rules synthesized from alerts, certified by the oracle

Grid: Sherlock (reconstructed). Alert = 60 s of telemetry starting at the first D1 physics-residual alarm inside the attack window, or at the attack start when D1 does not fire (stand-in for another detector). Noise level = largest invariant residual on train telemetry, globally, or per topology when that topology has at least 300 train records and its level is larger. The synthesizer uses only the alert records, the 30 s before, train telemetry (every 10th record, for noise levels) and the oracle. Family P: physical invariant (reported quantity minus the linearised AC prediction from metered injections, topology at the alert), margin = 1.5 x max(oracle AC residual bound, train noise). Family S: state change (line out, load or DER to zero). Certification: joint DE search (6000 power flows per round) and the robust exact layer (linearised AC, rule-specific bound 1.25 x AC bound); CEGIS on the margin for family P (at most 5 rounds). Wall time 340 s.
